name: bnb
cmd: $PY -m pip install -q bitsandbytes && $PY -c 'import bitsandbytes as b; print("LAYA_BNB", b.__version__)'

name: trees
cmd: R=$(cd $S/../../.. && pwd); cd $R && git fetch -q origin laya-decision-best laya-decision-perf-rebased && for t in 't_pr 84db80f0a' 't_dh 12fcce54c' 't_ours origin/laya-decision-perf-rebased' 't_best1 e7f0d9055' 't_best2 origin/laya-decision-best'; do set -- $t; [ -d $ROOT/$1 ] || git worktree add -q --detach $ROOT/$1 $2; echo "LAYA_TREE $1 $(git -C $ROOT/$1 log -1 --format='%h %s')"; done

name: clef_t_best2
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_best2 && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -k clef_loads_scores --tb=long -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Warning|warnings.warn|it/s\]|^\s*$' | grep -A200 -E '(FAILURES|^E |Error|passed|failed)' | head -150
